items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: I heard a band playing... Alexander Right Time Band.

ctx.x: No, I heard him up here. I heard him up here. I didn't hear him, no. I needed to do it. The only... We didn't have no big dances at my home. The Excursion bands used to come out there. You see, when they had the band Excursion, that's the only big band. Sometimes White would come by there, too. I heard a band playing... The first time I heard that was a long time ago.

Yeah, and I loved Liza, you know, and they played that about... You see, they take water at the place where it was. And I went up and I said, what's the name of that piece? He told me. Alexander Right Time Band. And that ain't been the date. That's an old number. That's an old number.
